'''Hell Knights''' are the second strongest species of the Baron class in [[Doom RPG]].

They are stronger than [[Ogre]]s but weaker than the [[Baron of Hell/Doom RPG|Barons of Hell]]. They have brown torso, brown hands, and pink legs.
